visual_identity.core_identity: A filthy refuse-dwelling aberration with three stout legs, two long grasping tentacles, one elevated eyestalk, and a broad central mouth.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low bulky central body supported by three legs, two long tentacles reaching outward, single eye stalk rising above.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate head; one elevated eye and a huge mouth lined with blunt irregular teeth occupy the central body.
visual_identity.body_shape: Round heavy torso with three thick legs and two flexible grasping tentacles.
visual_identity.surface: Tough hide with sparse folds, warts, and garbage residue kept simple.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly three stout weight-bearing legs support the central body. Exactly two long grasping tentacles extend outward, and exactly one separate eyestalk rises above the central mouth.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one low bulky central body with exactly three thick legs, exactly two long grasping tentacles, exactly one elevated eyestalk, and one large mouth embedded in the body. No separate head, humanoid torso, extra eyestalks, or octopus-style tentacle count.

accuracy_checks: garbage setting is clear without clutter

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
